adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action explicitly notes `// TODO: should clear the input` and does not clear `this.usernames` after calling `this.get("model").addMembers(...)`. The add button in `group.hbs` also has no `disabled` binding/guard, so repeated clicks will re-issue the same PUT. Additionally, `addMembers` does not `return`/handle the promise from `model.addMembers` (no `.then`/error handling), so any server error (e.g. 422 for automatic groups) would not be surfaced here. However, the claim that the server has no idempotency guard for already-present members / that duplicates will result is not verifiable from this diff because `group.add(user)` may already be idempotent at the model/DB level.
